goal: Design the Career OS Phase F trace/contract architecture as a conceptual run trace plus bounded typed phase envelopes. Architecture only; no runtime implementation.
acceptance_conditions: The report defines CAREER_OS_RUN_TRACE_V1 conceptually only, with no runtime schema file or implementation.

The run trace makes canonical SHA, run identity, inputs, sources attempted, unavailable sources, state transitions, suppression reasons, model/tool provenance where relevant, human handoffs, artifact hashes, QA outcomes, terminal state, first point of divergence, and first causal failure point reconstructable without a chat transcript.
Trace fields preserve evidence honesty: unknown or unavailable facts stay explicit rather than inferred; provenance quality remains distinguishable from reconstructed narrative.

provenance_quality on each trace fact is the three-value evidence-quality subset OBSERVED / RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_DURABLE_EVIDENCE / MISSING; EXPERIMENTAL_NON_CANONICAL is excluded from provenance_quality and remains a case/architecture-status label, not a per-fact evidence-quality value.

The design separates end-to-end terminal outcome from step-level diagnostics and distinguishes terminal_state, first_point_of_divergence, and first_causal_failure_point as three never-conflated concepts, applying the recoverable-divergence rule: a first_point_of_divergence that a later gate in the run's own trajectory recovers from is never labeled first_causal_failure_point merely because it occurred first.

The multi-divergence rule holds exactly: first_point_of_divergence always names the earliest identifiable divergence point in a run, including one that was later recovered; every identifiable first_causal_failure_point is itself a divergence point but equals the run's first_point_of_divergence only when no earlier recovered divergence exists; in a run with an earlier recovered divergence A followed by a distinct, later, unrecovered divergence B, first_point_of_divergence is A and first_causal_failure_point is B, at two different points in the same run. No identifiable first_causal_failure_point is claimed to be the run's first_point_of_divergence merely because it is an identifiable divergence point. The symmetric CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY label for an uninstrumented boundary is preserved unchanged.

The mixed attribution case is preserved: a run may have an identifiable, recovered first_point_of_divergence = A while the run's actual causal defect lived in a separate, later, uninstrumented boundary with no identifiable point B; in that case first_point_of_divergence = A is preserved unchanged (never wiped or reattributed) and first_causal_failure_point is separately recorded as CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY rather than a fabricated point B; the fully-uninstrumented symmetric pair case (both fields CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY) remains preserved unchanged alongside it.

Success-vs-failure absence semantics are locked: CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY is reserved exclusively for an incorrect terminal_state where a real divergence or causal failure exists but no instrumented point is identifiable; for a correct terminal_state with no divergence, first_point_of_divergence is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE / NO_DIVERGENCE; for any correct terminal_state, first_causal_failure_point is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE / NO_TERMINAL_FAILURE, including when a recovered first_point_of_divergence = A is preserved unchanged; CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY is never used on a correct-terminal success case for either field, and the pre-existing identifiable A->B failure case, the mixed failure case (first_point_of_divergence = A with first_causal_failure_point = CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY), and the fully-uninstrumented incorrect-terminal pair case (both fields CAUSE_UNKNOWN / UNINSTRUMENTED_BOUNDARY) remain preserved unchanged.

Human-handoff architecture records the requested action, context transferred, human decision/confirmation source where available, and final outcome without fabricating machine observability past the human boundary.

human_handoffs entries exist only for genuine control-passing events to Bora (the human) and are never merged with model_tool_provenance, which records machine/model/tool-attributed consequential decisions; a model/tool decision is never recorded as a human_handoffs entry.

The design defines bounded phase/typed-envelope seams with explicit input references, output references, decision/state, evidence/provenance references, gate outcomes, error/unavailable states, and authority/handoff metadata where applicable.

The architecture distinguishes append-only trace facts/events from derived summaries so later interpretation cannot silently rewrite the underlying evidence trail; the protected append-only fields are exactly: canonical_sha, run_identity, inputs, sources_attempted, unavailable_sources, state_transitions, suppression_reasons, model_tool_provenance, human_handoffs, artifact_hashes, qa_outcomes, terminal_state, first_point_of_divergence, and first_causal_failure_point.
Artifact references use durable identity plus cryptographic hash semantics where artifacts exist; missing or gitignored artifacts are represented as unavailable rather than invented.
Model/tool provenance is captured only where materially relevant to reconstructing a consequential decision; the design does not require storing hidden reasoning or chain-of-thought.
The report explicitly states that CI regression evaluation remains distinct from live-run monitoring/incidence and makes no unsupported reliability or production-frequency claim.
No database, UI, vendor, storage engine, orchestration runtime, provider abstraction, new agent, model router, LLM judge, or production trace infrastructure is selected or implemented.
No Phase E case corpus, Phase D taxonomy, Candidate Truth, Employer Truth, Match Truth, application history, package generation, or submission behavior is re-adjudicated or mutated.

Phase F completes only as COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR / PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE / READ_ONLY_DESIGN_ONLY with implementation_authorized=false; Phase G and every later roadmap phase remain PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
The exact next seam after a reviewed and merged Phase F completion is Bora acceptance/correction of Phase F; acceptance itself does not implicitly authorize Phase G.
Cursor independent adversarial review is required on the frozen exact diff before commit/push/PR; Cursor may not repair its own findings.
stop_conditions: Stop if completing the architecture requires any production/runtime mutation or any path outside allowed_paths.
Stop if the design would require inventing unavailable evidence, hidden model reasoning, production incidence, or artifact existence not established by durable records.
Stop if a database, UI, vendor, storage engine, provider abstraction, model router, new agent, LLM judge, or orchestration implementation would need to be selected.
Stop if Phase F architecture would alter Phase E's accepted 15-case eval-set substance or Phase D's accepted failure taxonomy rather than consuming them as inputs.
Stop if a proposed trace field cannot be justified by the accepted roadmap or observed Phase B-E evidence and is merely fashionable telemetry.
Stop at Bora human acceptance/correction gate after a reviewed/merged Phase F completion; do not authorize Phase G implicitly.
